title: Geolocation Convention
description: Schema for the geolocation Zarr convention

oneOf.title: Array
oneOf.description: A Zarr array node whose elements the geolocation arrays locate.

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and properties
attributes.title: Attributes

conventionMetadata.description: Geolocation convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention
schema_url.title: Schema URL

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document
spec_url.title: Specification URL

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention
uuid.title: Convention UUID

description.description: This convention provides a standard way to store geolocation arrays
description.title: Convention description

geodetic.title: Geodetic arrays
geodetic.description: Arrays of longitude (x) and latitude (y) for each element.

planar.title: Planar arrays
planar.description: Arrays of planar coordinates (x and y) for each element, in the CRS given by id.

geolocation.title: Geolocation
geolocation.description: References to arrays of geodetic and/or planar coordinates for each element of the array; at least one of the two.

x.title: X array
x.description: Reference to the array of X (west-east) coordinates: longitudes for geodetic arrays.

y.title: Y array
y.description: Reference to the array of Y (south-north) coordinates: latitudes for geodetic arrays.

id.title: CRS (proj)
id.description: CRS of the coordinate values, in the fields of the proj convention; it must agree with the x and y arrays.

arrays.title: Geolocation arrays
arrays.description: References to the x and y coordinate arrays, and the CRS of their values.
